subject: Dedicated reservation: GPU sculpting + ramp grace proposal for Spectra AI
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Keller <elaine.keller@spectraai.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated reservation: GPU sculpting + ramp grace proposal for Spectra AI

Hi Elaine —

Happy to follow up from our product+infra call. Based on the workload profile you shared (avg 2–6k qps inference, mix of generation and embeddings, bursty batch jobs each night), we put together a reservation structure that aims to: minimize your steady-state unit cost, preserve headroom for monthly bursts, and avoid a hard commitment cliff during your first 90 days in production. Key points in the attached draft:

- Baseline cluster: 48 A100-class equivalent GPUs (region us-west-2) as the committed floor.
- Minimum activatable GPU floor: 8 GPUs per region for geo-failover (we recommend us-west + us-east).
- Ramp schedule: 48 -> 96 GPUs over 16 weeks, triggered by usage thresholds (weeks 0–4: 48 baseline; weeks 5–12: +24 GPUs at 50% utilization; weeks 13–16: final +24 GPUs).
- Grace/ramp credits: 6 weeks of 50% usage credit on newly activated GPUs (applies to first activation tranche only).
- Burst carve-out: +20% on-demand burst capacity with automatic throttling to preserve SLOs; charged at lower-than-on-demand discounted rate for first 3 months.
- Pre-warm buffer: We’ll reserve a warm pool of 4 GPUs per zone to reduce cold-starts for long-context models.

Operational safeguards: automated fallback to our hosted model variants if regional queue latency exceeds SLO for >3 consecutive minutes, and automatic model-variant swap to lower-quantization variant under heavy tail load.

Attachments: spectraai_draft_offer.pdf (proposal details) and SPECTRA_MATP_COST_SPREADSHEET.xlsx (tokenized cost model by ramp phase).

Can you confirm an internal procurement lead so we can add DocuSign and HubSpot links? If this looks directionally correct, we’ll update pricing lines to reflect the 24-month commitment discount you asked about.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated reservation: GPU sculpting + ramp grace proposal for Spectra AI

Markus / Ben — forwarding Elaine's procurement questions. Quick proposed answers below so we can finalize the PDF: 

> 1) Cost delta during 6-week grace period
- We propose a measured credit that covers 50% of the billable hours on newly added GPUs for first 6 weeks. Practically this means first-tranche add (weeks 5–12) GPUs will show 50% discount for billing lines attributable to ramp activation. Per-hour: if baseline committed GPU rate is $2.60/hr (post-discount), ramp-credit GPUs bill at effectively $1.30/hr for the credit window. We'll surface per-token numbers in the spreadsheet.

> 2) Faster expansion (e.g., +40 GPUs in week 6)
- We can typically activate extra capacity within 48–72 hours subject to regional availability. Credits: extra GPUs added within the first 30 days of ramp will inherit the same pro-rated ramp credit (calculated on activation date). After 30 days, standard committed rates apply.

> 3) 8-GPU warm standby billing
- Warm standby floor is billable as part of the committed reservation (we bill the floor regardless of traffic). However, because it is designated as warm/standby, we offer a 25% standby discount against the committed rate for those GPUs for the first 3 months if no traffic is observed.

Operational notes for security ask: SOC 2 Type II artifact can be provided from our security portal (I will attach the signed report), and private deployment supports AWS account-level VPC peering with customer-managed KMS for key material. Markus, can you confirm the availability of the pre-warm buffer and whether we should recommend 2 or 4 GPUs per zone?

Thanks — Grace

Thanks all — circling back with the finalized recommendations and the DocuSign link. Changes from the draft: 

- Pre-warm buffer: adjusted to 2 GPUs per AZ (4 total across two regions) to keep cost predictable while still improving cold-start performance.
- Ramp credits: clarified in offer that credits are applied per-activation event and pro-rated to the hour of activation (see line item A3 in attached PDF).
- Faster expansion: we support 48-hour hot-adds; on-demand burst is available up to +30% beyond committed pool at the discounted burst rate for the first 90 days.
- Standby billing: 8-GPU floor will be invoiced at committed rate but subject to a 25% standby credit if tracked utilization remains below 10% for a full billing cycle.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report and private deployment checklist uploaded to your Hub (link included in DocuSign cover).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/SPECTRA-ENV-7782
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543
